audit_metadata.summary: CRÍTICA: 15 consolidações principais identificadas. Dívida técnica em !important, duplicação de media queries e autoridade de layout conflitante em 3+ camadas.

critical_findings.recommendation: Reduzir !important removendo conflitos raiz. Não aumentar especificidade.

consolidations.title: Autoridade de Largura de Página Distribuída em 7 Camadas de CSS
consolidations.description: Variáveis CSS para largura de página definidas com fallbacks em cascata: --doke-shared-page-width, --doke-current-page-rail, --doke-header-rail, --doke-page-rail. Múltiplos arquivos tentam controlar a mesma coisa.

files.responsibility: Sobreposição para header com --app-header-rail e fallbacks

consolidations.root_cause: Camadas de fallbacks acumuladas em vez de autoridade clara
consolidations.impact: Alto - difícil manter, fácil criar bugs quando uma camada muda
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Converter page-responsive-contract.css em mixin CSS em tokens.css
2. Unificar em único ponto: tokens.css com media queries
3. Remover app-header-rail, usar --doke-current-page-rail diretamente
4. Documentar autoridade: tokens.css > responsive-page-contract.css > componentes

consolidations.title: 3 Arquivos Competindo por Controle de Layout Mobile/Tablet
consolidations.description: responsive-layout-guards.css, remaining-pages.css e marketplace-responsive-stack.css fazem ajustes similares para mesmas páginas, com alto uso de !important.

files.responsibility: Stage 14 - overrides para messages, community, detail, payment, wallet
Stage 8 - escopo genérico, similar ao responsive-layout-guards
Phase 4 - consolidação de componentes, mas também faz overrides globais

consolidations.root_cause: Múltiplos estágios de refatoração sem consolidação entre eles
consolidations.impact: CRÍTICA - 150 !important no total, risco alto de bugs em mudanças futuras
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Unificar em arquivo único: responsive-mobile-tablet-overrides.css
2. Remover !important removendo conflitos base:
   - Verificar CSS que gera conflito
   - Aumentar especificidade do CSS original, não do override
3. Manter apenas 1 arquivo para cada breakpoint:
   - @media (max-width: 760px) → mobile-layout-contract.css
   - @media (max-width: 1024px) → tablet-layout-contract.css
   - @media (max-width: 1180px) → desktop-compact-contract.css
consolidations.estimated_reduction: Redução de 40% dos arquivos de padrões responsivos

consolidations.title: Breakpoints Inconsistentes Distribuídos em 20+ Arquivos
consolidations.description: Media queries em diferentes breakpoints: 360px, 420px, 520px, 560px, 640px, 760px, 820px, 900px, 980px, 1024px, 1080px, 1120px, 1180px, 1200px, 1320px, 1440px. Falta consolidação em arquivo único de tokens.
consolidations.root_cause: Cada arquivo define seus próprios breakpoints sem referência centralizada
consolidations.impact: ALTA - difícil manter responsividade consistente, risco de breakpoint drift
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Criar assets/css/core/breakpoints.css com definição única:
   --bp-mobile-xs: 360px
   --bp-mobile-sm: 420px
   --bp-mobile-md: 520px
   --bp-tablet: 760px
   --bp-tablet-lg: 900px
   --bp-desktop-sm: 1024px
   --bp-desktop-md: 1180px
   --bp-desktop-lg: 1440px
2. Refatorar todos arquivos para usar apenas estes breakpoints
3. Remover hardcoded media queries onde possível
consolidations.estimated_reduction: Eliminação de 15+ linhas de media query duplicadas por arquivo

consolidations.title: app-shell.css em 2 Locais com Responsabilidades Conflitantes
consolidations.description: assets/css/pages/app-shell.css importa assets/css/components/shell/app-shell.css, mas a definição real está no componente. Arquivo em pages/ é só ponte, criando confusão.

files.responsibility: Bridge file only, just imports component version
Canonical source - but not clear from location

consolidations.root_cause: Refatoração incompleta: arquivo de bridge não foi removido
consolidations.impact: MÉDIA - confusão sobre autoridade, risco de developer editar arquivo errado
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Remover assets/css/pages/app-shell.css
2. Manter apenas assets/css/components/shell/app-shell.css
3. Atualizar comment em app-shell.css: /* Canonical shell ownership - source of truth for app shell */
4. Se necessário manter bridge para compatibility, documentar explicitamente que é redirect-only

consolidations.title: 16 Arquivos de Layout da Página 'home' Poderiam Ser Consolidados
consolidations.description: Pasta assets/css/pages/home/ contém 16 arquivos pequenos e especializados para tablet/mobile. Muitas sobrepõem umas às outras.

files.description: Generic tablet responsive layout (overlaps with safari version?)
Refresh animation - could be in home.css or animations
Popover styles - could be in components

consolidations.root_cause: Gradual growth without consolidation. Each feature added as separate file.
consolidations.impact: ALTA - increased HTTP requests, harder to maintain, duplicated selectors across files
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Consolidar mobile/ em único arquivo: home-mobile.css
2. Consolidar tablet/ em único arquivo: home-tablet.css
3. Mover tablet-safari-layout.css logic em home-tablet.css com @supports (webkit)
4. Mover home-overlays, home-refresh, home-ux-popovers em home.css ou em layout file
5. Resultado: home/ folder com apenas 4-5 files max
files_to_consolidate: home/home-overlays.css + home-refresh.css + home-ux-popovers.css → home.css or home-components.css

consolidations.title: 20+ Variáveis --doke-* Definidas em Múltiplos Arquivos
consolidations.description: Mesmas variáveis como --doke-app-shell-gutter, --doke-app-shell-max, definidas em tokens.css mas redefinidas/sobrescritas em page-responsive-contract.css, tokens.css, e outros.
consolidations.root_cause: Multiple refactoring stages created separate variable namespaces without consolidation
consolidations.impact: MÉDIA - cognitive load, maintenance burden, inconsistency risk
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Audit all --doke-* and --stage* and --responsive-* variables
2. Consolidate into single namespace in tokens.css: --doke-layout-*
3. Merge --stage8-* and --responsive-layout-* into main tokens
4. Create tokens-mobile.css with mobile-only overrides
5. Document each variable's purpose and responsibility

consolidations.title: Página 'configuracoes' com 3 Subpastas de CSS Competindo
consolidations.description: assets/css/pages/configuracoes/ contém: configuracoes.css (main) + mobile-settings-index.css + mobile-header-drawer.css. Responsabilidades sobrepostas.

files.responsibility: Main page styles, but also includes mobile responses
Mobile-specific, duplicates some selectors from main
Mobile header drawer - could be component

consolidations.root_cause: Mobile files created as separate after mobile view was added
consolidations.impact: MÉDIA - 3 files with competing selectors, hard to find where to edit
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Merge mobile-settings-index.css into configuracoes.css in @media (max-width: 760px) section
2. Move mobile-header-drawer.css to assets/css/components/navigation/ or merge into configuracoes.css
3. Restructure configuracoes.css:
   - Desktop-first base styles
   - @media (max-width: 1024px) - tablet
   - @media (max-width: 760px) - mobile (merged from mobile-*.css)
   - @supports (webkit) - browser-specific if needed
4. Result: All settings page CSS in single file with clear media query sections

consolidations.title: Grid Template Columns Repeated 50+ Times Across Files
consolidations.description: Pattern 'grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))' and variants appear in 15+ files. Could be in shared utility.
consolidations.root_cause: No CSS utility/mixin system for common grid patterns
consolidations.impact: MÉDIA - code duplication, harder to maintain consistency
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Create assets/css/core/grid-utilities.css with common patterns:
   --grid-cols-1: minmax(0, 1fr)
   --grid-cols-2: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
   --grid-cols-3: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
   --grid-cols-4: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
   --grid-cols-auto: auto minmax(0, 1fr)
2. Replace all 'grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))' with 'grid-template-columns: var(--grid-cols-2)'
3. Advantage: single point of change for grid patterns
files_to_consolidate: Distribute grid-utilities.css across all files using grid patterns
consolidations.estimated_reduction: 50+ lines of duplicated CSS removed across files

consolidations.title: Header Height Defined in 5 Different Files
consolidations.description: Header/topbar height controlled by: app-header.css, internal-page-header.css, internal-shell.css, app-topbar.css patterns, and individual pages.
consolidations.root_cause: Multiple files trying to control header without clear authority
consolidations.impact: MÉDIA - risk of layout shifts, hard to find header height definition
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Define header contract in single file: assets/css/components/shell/app-header-contract.css
2. Document header heights:
   --header-height-desktop: 64px
   --header-height-mobile: 56px
   --header-height-tablet: 60px
3. All other files reference these variables, don't redefine
4. app-header.css is canonical source for header style only
5. internal-page-header.css and similar reference it

consolidations.title: Sidebar Width Defined Multiple Times: 260px, 280px, 320px, 360px, 382px
consolidations.description: Different pages define sidebar widths differently without coordination. Perfil uses 360px, configuracoes uses 382px at desktop.
consolidations.root_cause: Each page/component designed independently without shared rail contract
consolidations.impact: MÉDIA - visual inconsistency, harder to maintain responsive grid
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Create assets/css/core/rail-contract.css:
   --rail-width-mobile: 0 (hidden or collapsed)
   --rail-width-tablet: 280px
   --rail-width-desktop: 360px
   --rail-width-desktop-lg: 382px (if different)
2. Define responsive breakpoints where rails change width
3. Document which pages use which rail width
4. Standardize across all pages to use these variables
files_to_consolidate: Create rail-contract.css and standardize across pages

consolidations.title: overflow: hidden|auto|scroll Defined in 20+ Places Without Pattern
consolidations.description: No centralized approach to managing overflow. Used ad-hoc throughout codebase to fix layout issues.
consolidations.root_cause: Fixing layout issues by adding overflow rules instead of fixing root cause
consolidations.impact: BAIXA - works but indicates deeper layout problems may exist
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Audit each overflow: hidden|auto|scroll
2. Determine if fixing root cause is better (usually is)
3. Document cases where overflow is intentional
4. Create patterns/overflow-contract.css if overflow patterns are needed
5. Review AGENTS.md principles: Prefira consolidar regra existente
files_to_consolidate: Reduce overflow declarations by fixing root CSS conflicts
consolidations.estimated_reduction: Potential 30% reduction in overflow rules after fixing conflicts

consolidations.title: min-width: 0 | min-height: 0 Repeated 40+ Times - Sign of Flex/Grid Issues
consolidations.description: Heavy use of min-width: 0 and min-height: 0 indicates text truncation or flex sizing issues that should be fixed at source.
consolidations.root_cause: Workaround for flex/grid containers not respecting content width. Usually need better container sizing strategy.
consolidations.impact: BAIXA - works but indicates architectural issues
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Audit each min-width: 0 usage
2. Document which are necessary (text truncation with text-overflow: ellipsis) vs unnecessary
3. For unnecessary ones: fix parent flex/grid (gap, justify-content, flex-basis)
4. Create component pattern if min-width: 0 is justified
5. Consolidate justified uses into mixin if possible
consolidations.estimated_reduction: Potential 50% reduction if architectural fixes applied

consolidations.title: height: 100dvh | height: 100% Competing in Same Containers
consolidations.description: Páginas como configuracoes.css use height: 100dvh em alguns lugares e height: 100% em outros, sem clear contract.
consolidations.root_cause: No contract for viewport-based sizing vs content-based sizing
consolidations.impact: BAIXA - mostly works but risky for future changes
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Create height-contract.css:
   --height-viewport-full: 100dvh (use for page root)
   --height-content-full: 100% (use for content containers)
   --height-viewport-safe: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height))
2. Document which containers should use which height
3. Standardize usage across codebase

consolidations.title: display: grid vs display: flex Switching for Same Elements
consolidations.description: Elements change between grid and flex in @media queries without clear contract. tablet-responsive-layout.css shows many 'display: grid' then 'display: flex' switches.

files.lines: Multiple switches between grid and flex

consolidations.root_cause: Layout model chosen based on breakpoint rather than semantic need
consolidations.impact: BAIXA - works but risky for content/design changes
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. Audit each display: grid vs flex switch
2. Determine if same layout model could work across breakpoints
3. Use grid-template-columns: responsive for most cases instead of switching to flex
4. Document exceptions where display change is necessary
5. Create display-contract.css if needed
files_to_consolidate: Reduce display model switching in responsive CSS
consolidations.estimated_reduction: Simpler responsive CSS, fewer layout shifts

consolidations.title: Complex Selectors Used to Fight !important Instead of Removing Conflicts
consolidations.description: Selectors like 'body.payment-page-shell .payment-summary { position: static !important; }' are using high specificity AND !important instead of removing the conflicting rule.
consolidations.root_cause: CSS debt accumulation - fixing symptoms rather than root causes
consolidations.impact: BAIXA - works currently but CSS is brittle
consolidations.consolidation_plan:
1. For each body.page-shell override:
   - Find the base CSS rule creating conflict
   - Reduce specificity of base rule (remove unnecessary selectors)
   - Remove !important from override
   - Result: simpler, more maintainable CSS cascade
2. Example: Instead of 'body.payment-page-shell .payment-summary { position: static !important; }'
   Change source rule to not use position: absolute in this context
3. Document: When adding page-specific overrides, always check if base rule can be fixed first

file_organization_recommendations.current_structure: Mixed responsibility - pages, components, patterns, core all have overlapping concerns

assets/css/core/.tokens.css: Design system tokens ONLY - colors, typography, spacing, border-radius
assets/css/core/.layout-contract.css: Global page width, max-width, gutter sizing

assets/css/components/.shell/: App shell, header, navigation (ONLY component-specific, not layout overrides)

assets/css/pages/.home.css: Home page (keep structure for home variants)

Shared patterns ONLY - not page-specific, not layout overrides
